task: H3 METRIC-DOMAIN RECONCILIATION + FROZEN DOWNSTREAM EVALUATION + NOTEBOOK 06

problem_statement.summary: Notebook 05 (H3 supply-axis evaluation) correctly measured LOCALIZER/PROPOSAL supply but also substituted the proposal-level TINY coverage90 value into the formal downstream R_H3 formula and displayed the result as though it were the adjudicative downstream R_H3. The frozen prospective H3 design does NOT define formal R_H3 at the localizer-only proposal level.

misused_quantity.definition: Fraction of the 72 canonical clean-v3 FULL_FIELD VAL TINY GT components whose best proposal ROI covers >= 90% of the component, under the frozen decode (threshold=0.10, margin=0.20, top_k=5, nms_iou=0.30). This is a PROPOSAL/LOCALIZER metric, not a downstream segmentation recall.
misused_quantity.reason_formal_use_is_invalid: The frozen prospective design defines TinyRecall_H3 for the formal R_H3 as the DOWNSTREAM TINY Recall@0.90 obtained after the frozen Stage-4D proposal policy AND the frozen Phase-14 regional refiner AND fusion. A localizer/proposal coverage fraction is a strictly upstream quantity and is not the downstream segmentation recall. Substituting it changes the metric domain and yields a number that is not the prospective R_H3.

preserved_supply_results.note: Unchanged. These LOCALIZER/PROPOSAL SUPPLY results remain valid and are NOT reinterpreted or tuned.

prospective_protocol_evidence.design_protocol_downstream_eval_plan: H3 localizer -> heatmap (128) -> generate_predicted_rois(threshold=0.10, margin=0.20, top_k=5, nms_iou=0.30) -> proposal union (MAX-prob replacement) -> Phase-14 refiner epoch56 -> segmentation -> per-size recall
prospective_protocol_evidence.conclusion: The frozen prospective design binds TinyRecall_H3 to the downstream pipeline (post-refiner segmentation recall), not to the localizer-only proposal coverage. The proposal-domain substitution in Notebook 05 is therefore a metric-domain mismatch, now reconciled additively.

H3_PROPOSAL_TINY_COVERAGE90.role: Supply-axis diagnostic only; NOT the formal downstream TinyRecall_H3.

H3_DOWNSTREAM_TINY_RECALL90.role: The formal TinyRecall_H3 used in the prospective R_H3. Computed by the frozen downstream evaluation (this task). See reports/audits/h3_downstream_evaluation.json.

FORMAL_DOWNSTREAM_R_H3.role: The formal prospective R_H3 = (H3_DOWNSTREAM_TINY_RECALL90 - Tg) / G.

reconciliation_actions.proxy_relabelled: LOCALIZER-ONLY PROXY — NOT FORMAL DOWNSTREAM R_H3
